target.rawSql:
WITH samples AS (
  (SELECT p.pulled_at, ci.system_uptime_seconds
   FROM pull p
   JOIN customer_status_connection_info ci ON ci.pull_id = p.id
   WHERE p.pulled_at < $__timeFrom()
   ORDER BY p.pulled_at DESC
   LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.pulled_at, ci.system_uptime_seconds
  FROM pull p
  JOIN customer_status_connection_info ci ON ci.pull_id = p.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.pulled_at)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT p.pulled_at, ci.system_uptime_seconds
   FROM pull p
   JOIN customer_status_connection_info ci ON ci.pull_id = p.id
   WHERE p.pulled_at > $__timeTo()
   ORDER BY p.pulled_at
   LIMIT 1)
), boots AS (
  SELECT pulled_at,
    pulled_at - system_uptime_seconds * interval '1 second' AS boot_at
  FROM samples
), changes AS (
  SELECT *,
    lag(boot_at) OVER (ORDER BY pulled_at) AS previous_boot_at,
    lag(pulled_at) OVER (ORDER BY pulled_at) AS previous_pull
  FROM boots
)
SELECT
  date_trunc('second', boot_at) AS time,
  'Estimated modem reboot' AS text,
  'reboot' AS tags
FROM changes
WHERE boot_at > previous_boot_at + interval '30 seconds'
  AND boot_at >= previous_pull - interval '30 seconds'
  AND $__timeFilter(boot_at)
ORDER BY boot_at;

panels.title: Modem uptime

panels.description: The locked channel count divided by 32 expected downstream channels and 4 expected upstream channels.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_pull AS (
  SELECT id, pulled_at
  FROM pull
  ORDER BY pulled_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  p.pulled_at AS time,
  'Downstream' AS metric,
  LEAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.lock_status = 'Locked') / 32.0, 1) AS value
FROM latest_pull p
LEFT JOIN downstream_channel d
  ON d.pull_id = p.id AND d.pulled_at = p.pulled_at
GROUP BY p.pulled_at
UNION ALL
SELECT
  p.pulled_at AS time,
  'Upstream' AS metric,
  LEAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE u.lock_status = 'Locked') / 4.0, 1) AS value
FROM latest_pull p
LEFT JOIN upstream_channel u
  ON u.pull_id = p.id AND u.pulled_at = p.pulled_at
GROUP BY p.pulled_at;

panels.title: Current clock drift

panels.description: Each segment shows a channel rate, weighted by sample duration. Counter decreases are excluded. The stack combines channel rates without a separate total.

targets.rawSql:
WITH deltas AS (
  SELECT
    pulled_at AS time,
    channel_id,
    uncorrectable_count - LAG(uncorrectable_count) OVER (
      PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY pulled_at
    ) AS count_delta,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      pulled_at - LAG(pulled_at) OVER (
        PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY pulled_at
      )
    )) AS seconds_delta
  FROM downstream_channel
  WHERE pulled_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz - interval '30 minutes' AND ($__timeTo())::timestamptz
)
SELECT
  time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, time) AS time,
  'Channel ' || channel_id::text AS metric,
  SUM(count_delta) / NULLIF(SUM(seconds_delta), 0) * 60.0 AS value
FROM deltas
WHERE time >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz
  AND seconds_delta > 0 AND count_delta >= 0
GROUP BY 1, channel_id
ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Downstream QAM SNR

panels.description: The latest 100 changes between consecutive samples for each channel. Times show the first observation of each change.

targets.rawSql:
WITH samples AS (
  (SELECT DISTINCT ON (channel_id) pulled_at, channel_id, frequency_hz
   FROM downstream_channel
   WHERE pulled_at < $__timeFrom()
   ORDER BY channel_id, pulled_at DESC)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pulled_at, channel_id, frequency_hz
  FROM downstream_channel
  WHERE $__timeFilter(pulled_at)
), compared AS (
  SELECT *,
    lag(frequency_hz) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY pulled_at) AS previous_hz
  FROM samples
), changes AS (
  SELECT pulled_at, channel_id, previous_hz, frequency_hz
  FROM compared
  WHERE $__timeFilter(pulled_at)
    AND previous_hz IS NOT NULL
    AND frequency_hz <> previous_hz
), latest AS (
  SELECT * FROM changes
  ORDER BY pulled_at DESC, channel_id
  LIMIT 100
)
SELECT
  pulled_at AS "First observed",
  channel_id::text AS "Channel",
  previous_hz / 1000000.0 AS "Previous MHz",
  frequency_hz / 1000000.0 AS "New MHz"
FROM latest
UNION ALL
SELECT
  NULL::timestamptz,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM samples WHERE $__timeFilter(pulled_at))
    THEN 'No frequency changes in this range'
    ELSE 'No samples in this range'
  END,
  NULL::numeric,
  NULL::numeric
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM changes)
ORDER BY "First observed" DESC, "Channel";

panels.title: Upstream width changes

targets.rawSql:
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz),
    time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, ($__timeTo())::timestamptz),
    '$resolution'::interval
  ) AS time
), pulls AS (
  SELECT id, pulled_at FROM pull WHERE $__timeFilter(pulled_at)
), downstream_counts AS (
  SELECT p.pulled_at,
    COUNT(d.channel_id) AS present,
    COUNT(d.channel_id) FILTER (WHERE d.lock_status = 'Locked') AS locked
  FROM pulls p
  LEFT JOIN downstream_channel d ON d.pull_id = p.id AND d.pulled_at = p.pulled_at
  GROUP BY p.pulled_at
), upstream_counts AS (
  SELECT p.pulled_at,
    COUNT(u.channel_id) AS present,
    COUNT(u.channel_id) FILTER (WHERE u.lock_status = 'Locked') AS locked
  FROM pulls p
  LEFT JOIN upstream_channel u ON u.pull_id = p.id AND u.pulled_at = p.pulled_at
  GROUP BY p.pulled_at
), deficits AS (
  SELECT pulled_at, 'Downstream missing' AS metric, 32 - present AS value FROM downstream_counts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pulled_at, 'Downstream unlocked', present - locked FROM downstream_counts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pulled_at, 'Upstream missing', 4 - present FROM upstream_counts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pulled_at, 'Upstream unlocked', present - locked FROM upstream_counts
), worst AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, pulled_at) AS time, metric,
    (array_agg(value ORDER BY abs(value) DESC, pulled_at DESC))[1] AS value
  FROM deficits GROUP BY 1, 2
), metrics(metric) AS (
  VALUES ('Downstream missing'), ('Downstream unlocked'), ('Upstream missing'), ('Upstream unlocked')
)
SELECT b.time, m.metric, w.value
FROM buckets b CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN worst w ON w.time = b.time AND w.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY b.time, m.metric;

panels.description: Zero means complete. Missing counts equal expected minus present; negative values mean extra channels. Unlocked counts equal present minus locked. Expected: 32 downstream, 4 upstream. Each bucket preserves the largest absolute deficit; empty buckets remain gaps.
panels.title: Channel bonding deficits

panels.description: Counts use first observation time. Buckets without pulls remain gaps. Log limits and identical records can hide events.

targets.rawSql:
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz),
    time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, ($__timeTo())::timestamptz),
    '$resolution'::interval
  ) AS time
), types(event_type, label) AS (
  VALUES
    ('sync_failure', 'Sync failures'),
    ('t3_timeout', 'T3 timeouts'),
    ('t4_timeout', 'T4 timeouts'),
    ('mdd_timeout', 'MDD timeouts'),
    ('dhcp_failure', 'DHCP failures'),
    ('dhcp_warning', 'DHCP warnings'),
    ('profile_change', 'Profile changes'),
    ('other', 'Other events')
), observations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, pulled_at) AS time
  FROM pull
  WHERE $__timeFilter(pulled_at)
), events AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, first_observed_at) AS time,
    event_type,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM modem_event
  WHERE $__timeFilter(first_observed_at) AND event_type <> 'collector_login'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  b.time,
  t.label AS metric,
  CASE WHEN o.time IS NOT NULL OR e.count IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(e.count, 0) END AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN types t
LEFT JOIN observations o ON o.time = b.time
LEFT JOIN events e ON e.time = b.time AND e.event_type = t.event_type
ORDER BY b.time, t.label;

panels.title: Modem event counts

panels.description: Collection time minus modem time, in minutes. Positive values mean that the modem clock trails collection time. Each bucket shows its average. Markers show estimated reboot times from uptime data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, p.pulled_at) AS time,
  AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM p.pulled_at) - ci.system_time_unix) / 60.0 AS "Clock drift"
FROM pull p
JOIN customer_status_connection_info ci ON ci.pull_id = p.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.pulled_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Clock drift history

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  first_observed_at AS "Observed",
  timestamp_at AS "Modem time",
  CASE level
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Emergency'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Alert'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Error'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Warning'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Notice'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Informational'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Debug'
    ELSE level::text
  END AS "Level",
  event_type AS "Type",
  message AS "Message"
FROM modem_event
WHERE $__timeFilter(first_observed_at)
  AND event_type <> 'collector_login'
ORDER BY first_observed_at DESC, timestamp_at DESC, message
LIMIT 100;

panels.description: The newest modem events by first observation time, with modem time and event type. Routine collector login events are hidden.
panels.title: Modem event log

panels.description: Reboots first detected in the selected range. Estimates use collection time minus uptime, with a 30-second tolerance. Multiple reboots between pulls can remain invisible.

targets.rawSql:
WITH samples AS (
  (SELECT p.pulled_at, ci.system_uptime_seconds
   FROM pull p
   JOIN customer_status_connection_info ci ON ci.pull_id = p.id
   WHERE p.pulled_at < $__timeFrom()
   ORDER BY p.pulled_at DESC
   LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.pulled_at, ci.system_uptime_seconds
  FROM pull p
  JOIN customer_status_connection_info ci ON ci.pull_id = p.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.pulled_at)
), boots AS (
  SELECT pulled_at,
    pulled_at - system_uptime_seconds * interval '1 second' AS boot_at
  FROM samples
), changes AS (
  SELECT *,
    lag(boot_at) OVER (ORDER BY pulled_at) AS previous_boot_at,
    lag(pulled_at) OVER (ORDER BY pulled_at) AS previous_pull
  FROM boots
)
SELECT
  date_trunc('second', boot_at) AS "Estimated reboot",
  pulled_at AS "First observed"
FROM changes
WHERE boot_at > previous_boot_at + interval '30 seconds'
  AND boot_at >= previous_pull - interval '30 seconds'
ORDER BY pulled_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Modem reboots

panels.description: Public IP by modem pull. A failed lookup leaves a gap. Colors follow the first observation of each IP and repeat after ten IPs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.pulled_at AS time,
  'Public IP' AS metric,
  oi.ip AS state
FROM pull p
LEFT JOIN own_ip oi ON oi.pull_id = p.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.pulled_at)
ORDER BY p.pulled_at;

WITH addresses AS (
  SELECT
    oi.ip,
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY min(p.pulled_at), oi.ip) - 1 AS color_index
  FROM own_ip oi
  JOIN pull p ON p.id = oi.pull_id
  WHERE oi.ip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oi.ip
), palette AS (
  SELECT ARRAY[
    '#4E79A7', '#F28E2B', '#E15759', '#76B7B2', '#59A14F',
    '#EDC948', '#B07AA1', '#FF9DA7', '#9C755F', '#BAB0AC'
  ] AS colors
)
SELECT
  ip AS "Value",
  ip AS "Text",
  colors[(color_index % cardinality(colors) + 1)::integer] AS "Color"
FROM addresses
CROSS JOIN palette
ORDER BY color_index;

panels.title: Public IP history
